source: CPython 3.12.16 on Darwin arm64, jsonschema 4.26.0, referencing 0.37, claude-agent-sdk 0.2.181. Each seed ran in fresh processes started with PYTHONHASHSEED set; the bridge answers come through ClaudeSDKClient against a stub CLI that sends the mcp_message requests, in the OK / ERR / RPCERR text format of python_schema.json.
assumptions: hashes are hash(s) of strings, in order.
specifications are the in_value, in_subarray and in_subvalues sets of each referencing.jsonschema specification, in iteration order, read from the subresources_of closure.
sets are list(set(keys)) of the keys lists, in order.
engine are list(cls(schema).iter_errors(instance)) for the validator_for class, with the str() of the exception that stopped it.
large is list(set("n%d" % i for i in range(count)))[::step], each key given by its i.
startup runs python -c 'print(hash("abc"))' twice with PYTHONHASHSEED set to text: invalid when Python refuses to start, random when the two runs differ, else fixed with the hash.
